empty_hint: Choose another folder in Settings → Plugins.
hint: ← → browse · scroll browse · Enter apply · Esc close

apply_all.description: Apply to every monitor; when off, only to the focused monitor.
apply_all.label: Apply to all outputs

base_scale.description: Size of the cards around the selected one.
base_scale.label: Side card scale

card_height.description: Height of the selected card, in logical pixels.
card_height.label: Card height

card_width.description: Width of the selected card, in logical pixels.
card_width.label: Card width

chrome.description: Show the footer with the file name and the apply button.
chrome.label: Show the footer

close_on_apply.description: Close the carousel after applying a wallpaper.
close_on_apply.label: Close after applying

directory.description: Leave empty to use Noctalia's configured wallpaper folder.
directory.label: Wallpaper folder

hover_boost.description: How much the card under the pointer grows and brightens.
hover_boost.label: Hover emphasis

parallax.description: How much each thumbnail crop shifts with the card's position.
parallax.label: Parallax strength

scrim.description: Dark veil over the desktop. 0 keeps the background fully transparent.
scrim.label: Scrim opacity

selected_scale.description: Size of the selected card relative to the side cards.
selected_scale.label: Selected card scale

show_filenames.description: Show the selected file name. Works on its own; with the footer on, the name appears in the footer.
show_filenames.label: Show filenames

skew.description: How much the cards lean to the right when the shape is the skewed ribbon.
skew.label: Card skew

wheel.label: Scroll with the mouse wheel
wheel.description: Move the carousel with the mouse wheel. Off disables the wheel.

card_shape.description: Shape of every card. The preview is masked, so the ribbon keeps a continuous look.
card_shape.label: Card shape

open_random.description: Open on a random wallpaper every time. Off opens on the current desktop wallpaper.
open_random.label: Open at a random wallpaper

thumb_error: Could not generate thumbnails. Showing the original wallpapers.
title: Wallpapers
